_doc: Universal, entity-agnostic acceptance patterns for Brain OS. A pattern is a reusable obligation, not a hardcoded test: CAPABILITY_CONTRACTS.json declares what a capability is (states, transitions, flags, surfaces) and qa/runner/lib/contracts.mjs derives which of these patterns apply. Expected behaviour ALWAYS comes from a declared oracle (oracle_source), never from the current UI, the implementation, an existing test or prior assistant behaviour. Where the oracle is undefined the pattern's verdict is BLOCKED - PRODUCT POLICY UNDEFINED. Work-PC browser/adversarial acceptance remains the final authority.

MUTATION_TRUTH.intent: A claimed mutation equals the actual mutation on every axis.
steps: precondition: capture canonical state of the target (DB via reload/PostgREST, UI row, Brain read)
request: perform the mutation through the surface under test
actual execution result: capture the receipt/toast/reply verbatim
UI: the surface reflects the postcondition
receipt: names the same entity, relationship type and target as the DB diff
Brain claim: a fresh-channel read agrees
fresh read: a second independent read agrees
assertions: receipt names no entity/relationship absent from the diff
no success language when the diff is empty

INVERSE_LIFECYCLE.intent: A transition and its declared inverse restore the original state, including children and relationships.
assertions: all surfaces return to the pre-action rendering
relationships that existed before exist after

ALREADY_TARGET_STATE.intent: Repeating an action whose target is already in the target state is safe and truthfully described.
assertions: receipt says already-in-state or equivalent; never claims a change that did not occur

STALE_STATE.intent: When state changes between a read and an action (another surface/actor), behaviour is deterministic and safe.
steps: act on the stale view in surface A
assertions: no lost update silently overwriting B's change unless policy says last-writer-wins
oracle_source: BLOCKED - PRODUCT POLICY UNDEFINED unless CAPABILITY_CONTRACTS declares a concurrency policy

MISSING_TARGET.intent: Acting on a non-existent or deleted entity is refused truthfully.
assertions: no substitute target offered on a destructive verb unless it is an exact-prefix candidate set the user can choose from by explicit name
oracle_source: founder rule: a clarification must never bind a destructive verb to an entity the user did not name (BUG-005 regression)

UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR.intent: A role without the capability cannot perform it, directly or via Brain.
assertions: UI does not offer or fails safely
audit records the attempt where policy says so

FOREIGN_ORG_ACTOR.intent: A legitimate role in organization A cannot act on organization B's resources.
assertions: no foreign data in Brain context

CROSS_ORG_ISOLATION.intent: Tenant-scoped reads and pickers never expose another organization's entities.
assertions: list surfaces filter by the selected/authorized org consistently

PARENT_ARCHIVED_CHILD_BEHAVIOR.intent: Children of an archived parent behave per declared policy on every surface.
assertions: every child surface marks the archived parent
controls on children behave per policy (disabled / allowed / prompted)
counts exclude or include per policy consistently
oracle_source: BLOCKED - PRODUCT POLICY UNDEFINED for cascade semantics (BUG-013 DESIGN_DECISION_REQUIRED); marker visibility is defined by BUG-001 closure

RELOAD_TRUTH.intent: A full page reload shows exactly the persisted state.
instantiated_by: every C002 capability with RELOAD axis

FRESH_SESSION_TRUTH.intent: A new browser identity / second login sees the same persisted state (and only what it is authorized to).

CROSS_SURFACE_TRUTH.intent: Every surface that displays an entity agrees with the DB after a mutation.
assertions: list, detail, picker, dashboard count, selector, search, Brain all agree

AI_FRESH_GROUNDING.intent: Brain answers canonical-state questions from live data, in a fresh channel and after mutations.
assertions: named entity resolves on every command shape

CONVERSATION_HISTORY_CONFLICT.intent: When channel history contradicts canonical state, canonical state wins.
steps: produce or plant a false prior assistant claim in the channel
ask for canonical state with an explicit stored-data instruction
control: identical question in a fresh channel
assertions: repeat N>=10 times: the pattern is probabilistic (BUG-010 reproduced 1/4)
oracle_source: founder rule: fresh canonical state outranks history

PENDING_ACTION_CONFIRMATION.intent: A confirmation binds to exactly one pending action by id, action type and canonical target ids.
assertions: bound target id == id of the entity the USER named
a substitute offered by Brain is never bound by a bare affirmative
oracle_source: issue #5 founder suite items D, E

BARE_YES_WITH_VALID_PENDING_ACTION.intent: A bare yes executes exactly the one valid pending action and receipts it truthfully.

BARE_YES_WITHOUT_PENDING_ACTION.intent: A bare yes with nothing pending is refused and nothing executes.
assertions: no binding to other channels' actions
no prose naming other channels' work items
instantiated_by: BUG-005 Class E (isolation holds; prose leak residual)

UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.intent: An operation the surface cannot perform is declined honestly, with no implied capability.
assertions: no 'I will update X once found' when no field exists

FAILURE_RECEIPT_TRUTH.intent: When any structured step fails, the receipt contains no success summary for it.
assertions: no co-occurrence of a failure line and a success line for the same request
partial application is reported as partial

COLLECTION_TRUNCATION.intent: Truncated collections are presented with returnedCount/totalCount/isTruncated; totals come from aggregates.
assertions: counts never derived from the window
fixture rows counted consistently with real rows or the exclusion is stated

NAMED_ENTITY_OUTSIDE_CONTEXT_WINDOW.intent: An entity named in the command is looked up regardless of the capped collection.
assertions: named lookup exists for every entity type with a capped list
oracle_source: fix 15e868a design (companies) mirrored for people; extension rule in CLAUDE.md §13

LONG_CONTEXT_CONTINUITY.intent: Across 50/100/200 turns and compaction, declared anchors are either recalled correctly or their loss is stated honestly; never fabricated.

CHANNEL_ISOLATION.intent: Pending actions and history never cross channel boundaries.

NAVIGATION_CONTINUITY.intent: Leaving and returning to a channel preserves its pending action and history, and a survived pending action is still correctly bound.

MULTI_TURN_EXECUTION_ALIGNMENT.intent: Turn N's reply answers turn N, not N-1; each executed action is receipted in the turn that executed it.

MOBILE_BASIC_ACCEPTANCE.intent: Login, command, task, approval work at a mobile viewport; EN/MN navigation works.
MOBILE_BASIC_ACCEPTANCE.status: NOT YET INSTANTIATED on the Work PC
